quirks: Payment is Solana-only: paymentAccepts has a single entry network=solana, USDC asset EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v, payTo 9VaDVp1Wb78G4Wm6VuTiMrpESjrUymXefQTHcJGRSTEA. It does NOT accept Base/Tempo — the paying wallet must hold Solana USDC.
priceDisplay is 'Varies' but the live quote for a basic prompt was a flat $0.08; reference images / larger outputs may cost more.
Synchronous: the 200 response returns the finished image immediately (no job id / polling). Output aspect_ratio defaults to 1:1.
Result is at body.image_url (a CDN-hosted JPG); a body.metadata.replicate_url to the original .webp is also provided.
usage.guide: FLUX.2 Max image generation by Black Forest Labs via Xona. Call POST https://api.xona-agent.com/image/flux-2-max with a JSON body like {"prompt":"..."} (the description says it also supports reference images). It is synchronous and pays ~$0.08/call in USDC — CRITICAL: payment is Solana-only, so the paying wallet must hold Solana USDC (a Base balance will not work). On success (HTTP 200) read the generated image from body.image_url (a CDN-hosted JPG); body.metadata gives model, aspect_ratio (default 1:1), and the original replicate_url.
